courses_scope_check.name: courses_scope_check
courses_scope_check.value: (scope_type = 'department' AND department_id IS NOT NULL AND faculty_id IS NULL) OR (scope_type = 'faculty' AND faculty_id IS NOT NULL AND department_id IS NULL) OR (scope_type IN ('general', 'interfaculty') AND department_id IS NULL AND faculty_id IS NULL)

questions_track_check.name: questions_track_check
questions_track_check.value: (course_id IS NOT NULL AND jamb_subject_id IS NULL) OR (course_id IS NULL AND jamb_subject_id IS NOT NULL)

quizzes_track_check.name: quizzes_track_check
quizzes_track_check.value: (course_id IS NOT NULL AND jamb_subject_id IS NULL) OR (course_id IS NULL AND jamb_subject_id IS NOT NULL)

quizzes_type_check.name: quizzes_type_check
